title: US Sanctions Oil Tankers, Companies With Links to Venezuela
summary: The Trump administration added oil companies and tankers with ties to Venezuela to its list of sanctioned vessels, the latest effort from the federal government to exert economic pressure on the Nicolas Maduro’s regime.
